G20 Nations Divided on Future of Fossil Fuels

G20 nations are divided on the future of fossil fuels, particularly natural gas, with differing views on its role in the energy transition. Discussions highlight a divergence in strategies and timelines for phasing out or continuing the use of gas. The coverage suggests potential future scenarios for energy markets, including a "Great Gas Crisis of 2030," driven by these differing national approaches. The specific details of these divisions and their potential impacts are being debated among member states.
